subject: Staged onramp: org bootstrap, ephemeral API keys & peering timeline
messages:
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novamed.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Staged onramp: org bootstrap, ephemeral API keys & peering timeline

Evelyn —

Quick note from our side: we want to run a short POC against Redwood to validate latency and cost profiles for our bursty inference workloads. Target start date is Mar 1 (two-week trial). Can you send a MAP that covers: org bootstrap (invite + roles), API key issuance and rotation model (we prefer ephemeral/rotating keys), IP allowlisting, and VPC peering steps?

I've attached our internal security questionnaire to speed legal & security review. Specific asks from our infra team: a short checklist for required firewall rules and any required BGP or routing hints for peering.

Also please call out any SLOs we should expect during the POC and a proposed timeline to close.

Thanks — appreciate a tight plan so we can align internal reviewers.

Tom Reed
Head of Platform, NovaMed
Attachment: novamed-security-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novamed.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Staged onramp: org bootstrap, ephemeral API keys & peering timeline

Tom — thanks for the context and the questionnaire. I reviewed the sheet and put together an initial mutual action plan (attached) that breaks down the POC handoffs into discrete owners and dates. High-level items included in the MAP draft:

- Org bootstrap: invite NovaMed admins to our console, create tenant, map RBAC roles.
- API keys: issue initial ephemeral keys + documented rotation strategy (we support 24h rotation and short-lived tokens via our token service).
- IP allowlist: short list of CIDRs to configure at your firewall.
- VPC peering: preflight checklist (peer subnet planning, routing, security groups) and a recommended maintenance window.
- Acceptance tests: simple generation/latency smoke tests and token/audit-log verification.

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Feb 20: org invite & access granted; legal to confirm MAI
- Feb 22: API keys provisioned + key-rotation notes delivered
- Feb 23: IP allowlist + firewall rules confirmed
- Feb 27: VPC peering cutover window (off-peak, 02:00–04:00 PST)
- Mar 1: POC starts (2-week run)

Ask: please confirm the infra contact and the public IP ranges we should expect to be allowlisted. Also let us know any blackout windows for peering.

Attaching: redwood-map-draft.csv (MAP draft, CSV). I kept it intentionally small so your legal and infra teams can iterate quickly.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-map-draft.csv (CSV)

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novamed.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@novamed.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Staged onramp: org bootstrap, ephemeral API keys & peering timeline

Thanks Evelyn — this looks good and tight. Looping in our infra team (infra@novamed.com) who will own peering.

Quick answers:
- Infra contact: infra@novamed.com (cc'd)
- Current public prefixes we can allowlist: 18.205.0.0/16 and 3.92.0.0/15 (these are our egress NAT ranges)
- Peering window constraints: we prefer weekdays after 01:00 PST; Feb 27 02:00–04:00 PST should be fine.
- API keys: we need rotation every 24 hours and an audit trail of token issuance. If you can provide a sample rotation script or notes on how to call the token endpoint, that will expedite our devops work.

Attaching a simple peering diagram from our network team for reference. Legal is reviewing the MAI — I expect signature by Feb 20 and will follow up with a PDF once signed.

Tom Reed
Head of Platform, NovaMed
Attachment: peering-diagram.png (image)
Attachment: signed-mai.pdf (pending; will send when available)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novamed.com>, Infra Team <infra@novamed.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged onramp: org bootstrap, ephemeral API keys & peering timeline

Tom / NovaMed infra — thanks for the fast turnaround and the CIDRs. Confirming the MAP below and owners so we can close toward the Feb 20 MAI target. Quoting your note for clarity:

> On 2028-02-15, Tom Reed wrote:
> > Current public prefixes we can allowlist: 18.205.0.0/16 and 3.92.0.0/15
> > Peering window constraints: weekdays after 01:00 PST; Feb 27 02:00–04:00 PST should be fine.

Mutual action plan (finalized):
1) Org bootstrap (Evelyn) — deliver console invites for NovaMed admins and set RBAC mappings by 2028-02-20.
2) MAI signature (Tom / NovaMed legal) — target 2028-02-20.
3) API keys & rotation (Jonas) — provide ephemeral key provisioning and a sample rotation script + audit log config by 2028-02-22.
4) IP allowlist confirmation (Infra Team) — confirm rules and apply 18.205.0.0/16 and 3.92.0.0/15 by 2028-02-23.
5) VPC peering cutover (Naomi + Infra Team) — scheduled 2028-02-27 02:00–04:00 PST. Naomi will publish a short runbook and rollback checklist by 2028-02-25.
6) Acceptance tests (Evelyn + NovaMed devs) — smoke tests for generation latency and token audit verification during week 1 of POC (starting 2028-03-01).

Owners & immediate next steps:
- Evelyn: send console invites and redwood-map-final.csv to the group (by 02/20).
- Jonas: deliver token rotation script + doc (by 02/22).
- Naomi: publish peering runbook (by 02/25) and coordinate dry-run with NovaMed infra.
- Infra Team: confirm CIDRs applied and confirm reachability (by 02/23).
- Tom: confirm MAI signature and share signed PDF on HubSpot (by 02/20).

I also uploaded the finalized MAP to Drive and linked the HubSpot deal for tracking. You should see the HubSpot activity under DEAL-7893 and the Drive doc here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=maps-doc-abc

If anything needs to shift, flag it in this thread and we'll adjust the windows. Otherwise, I'll send the console invites and the final CSV map first thing Monday.

Best —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-map-final.csv (MAP final)
